archetype.label: Burner
archetype.desc: Eighty steals if you let him

phoneInbox.text: Just got the locker next to yours. Any advice? Honestly kind of terrified.

choices.label: Take him under your wing
choices.reply: Come in early tomorrow, we'll get extra swings in together. You'll be fine

choices.label: One line of advice
choices.reply: Learn the scouting reports before you learn the city. Rest follows

phoneInbox.text: Your postgame comments about last night's umpiring went viral. We'd welcome a public clarification.

choices.label: Apologize properly
choices.reply: I was out of line. Umpires have the hardest job on the field. Apologies

phoneInbox.text: New look idea for you. Bold. Might break the internet, might get you side eye from the manager. You in?

choices.label: Keep it classic
choices.reply: Usual cut mate, big series this week

phoneInbox.text: Been riding the bench again man. Thinking about asking for a trade. What would you do?

choices.label: Be honest with him
choices.reply: You deserve at bats mate. If he won't give them, go get them somewhere

choices.label: Tell him to stop whining
choices.reply: Outwork him then. Nobody owes you a lineup spot

choices.label: Dodge the question
choices.reply: Tough one bro. Sleep on it

phoneInbox.text: The hearing is the same week as my birthday. I'm not mad. I'm just saying it out loud so you know I know.

choices.label: Plan the birthday first
choices.reply: Birthday is booked. The hearing works around it

choices.label: We'll celebrate after
choices.reply: We'll do it big after the hearing, promise
